title: What Prahlada learned
hook: a demon king asks his son what school taught him, and the week's sounds gathered into three ways to love God
carry: hearing, singing, remembering: the first ways to love god
tomorrow: why would Nani gasp when you step over a notebook?

segments.voice: Yesterday, prana: the breath every power leans on, the life-breath the senses quarreled over and couldn't do without. Today, the week together, through a small boy's answer.

A parent picks a kid up and asks the oldest question: so, what did you learn at school? This parent is Hiranyakashipu, king of the demons, who hates Vishnu above everything. He takes his little son Prahlada on his lap and asks: of all you've learned, what's the best? Prahlada answers, sweetly, in front of everyone. And the room goes cold.
screen: `WHAT DID YOU LEARN AT SCHOOL?` → `A DEMON KING ASKS HIS SON.` → `THE ROOM GOES COLD.`

segments.voice: Here's what he says, in the Bhagavata Purana. The best learning is to love Vishnu in nine ways. Hearing about him. Singing about him. Remembering him. Serving his feet. Worshipping him. Bowing to him. Being his servant. Being his friend. And offering him everything you are. The king is furious and blames the teachers, who swear they taught no such thing. Later Prahlada tells his classmates where it came from: he heard the sage Narada teaching while he was still in his mother's womb. Hindus call this list navadha bhakti, the nine ways of devotion, and notice where it starts: with the ears and the voice. That's this week. Hearing: Shiva's drum and the word held sacred, shabda brahman, and Hanuman, who chose to spend forever listening to Rama's story. Singing: Tyagaraja, giving his voice to Rama instead of the king. Remembering: the name, said with care or said backwards, Valmiki's mara, mara, and Ajamila calling his son. And under all of it, prana, the breath every word rides on. The nine ways run on into service, worship and friendship. But the door Prahlada names first is the one this week walked through. Listen. Sing. Remember.
screen: `NINE WAYS TO LOVE VISHNU.` · `HEARD FROM NARADA, IN THE WOMB.` · `NAVADHA BHAKTI STARTS WITH SOUND.` · `HEARING, SINGING, REMEMBERING.` · then, large: `LISTEN. SING. REMEMBER.`

segments.voice: Choose one of the three. Hear: listen to one bhajan or chant you love, start to finish. Sing: hum one line of it. Remember: say one name of God slowly, three times. If you don't pray, choose a sound that matters to you and give it one full minute of attention. Then rest with the breath.
The sounds: this week, heard, sung and remembered, the first three of Prahlada's nine ways.
The week's line: hearing, singing, remembering, the first ways to love God. That's the week.

howItsDone: Hindus practice the first ways of devotion every day: listening to katha and bhajans, singing kirtan, and repeating a name of God in japa; Prahlada's list of nine is often taught to children.
